correctness.rationale: For exactly circulant A and an orthogonal Fourier projector Pi, block multiplication gives T_B=KR_B=[[I,0],[(I-PB)A*,PB]]. With B=P^{-1}Pi, T_0 is idempotent, and all transformed Krylov images are span{(b,(I-Pi)A*b)}, giving the exact persistent squared residual NE/(N+E) for all positive Krylov orders (mathematical spaces, even after Arnoldi breakdown). Every zero-start mask-restricted flexible iterate has physical second block in ran Pi; Fourier-mode least squares yields the stated sharp full-trial-space floor. For positive leakage epsilon, (T-I)(T-epsilon I)=0, T invertible; omitted 2x2 singular-value determinant and trace yield kappa_j and 1/epsilon asymptotics. Independent tests on 24 complex Fourier systems corroborated the identities.
